overview.name: Tradr 2X Short ORCL Daily ETF
overview.description: The Tradr 2X Short ORCL Daily ETF seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, that correspond to two times the inverse (-200%) daily performance of the common shares of ORCL. The fund is non-diversified.
